# Pal — Persistent Asset Library
> Personal AI with compounding memory. Like ChatGPT, but with hands.

Pal is a persistent-memory AI assistant that turns everything you capture, research, and build into reusable assets that compound over time. Built by GetBotPacks.

## What Pal Does
- Captures voice notes, links, ideas, and documents
- Researches topics, competitors, and markets on command
- Transforms captures into blog posts, SOPs, emails, LinkedIn posts, business plans, and more
- Remembers your preferences, projects, and communication style across every session
- Runs automations and scheduled jobs in the background

## Who It's For
Anyone who thinks for a living: founders, consultants, real estate agents, creators, operators.

## Pricing
- Free: 50 credits included
- Pro: $49/month — unlimited chat, full memory, research agent
- Business: $149/month — multi-user, priority support
- Agency: $249/month — white-label, client workspaces
- Annual plans: 20% off

## Key Features
- Persistent memory that compounds across every session
- Source-flexible research pipeline (YouTube, PDFs, web, Google Drive)
- Projects module with 10 life/business categories
- Health tracking (Oura Ring, nutrition, TDEE)
- LinkedIn, email, and social content generation
- Integrations: Stripe, Gmail, Discord, Slack, Oura, Firecrawl
